name: textual-css-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Textual, a Python framework for terminal user interfaces. This task concerns
its CSS subsystem: the Textual CSS language and its style reference, together with the color, geometry and
layout support it relies on.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the CSS subsystem of the textual package: every Python module under src/textual/css/ and src/textual/layouts/, together with src/textual/color.py, src/textual/geometry.py and src/textual/_layout_resolve.py; every documentation page under docs/styles/ and docs/css_types/ except the two _template.md pages; the guide pages docs/guide/CSS.md, docs/guide/styles.md and docs/guide/layout.md; and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with rich, markdown-it-py, mdit-py-plugins, platformdirs, typing-extensions,
pytest and pytest-asyncio, and has no network access; textual is imported from `/workdir/src`. Keep the public
API
